description: Ingest booked Zocdoc appointments via GET /v1/appointments into a pandas DataFrame, for operational/analytics reporting. PHI-safe by design: materialization metadata, logs, and error messages never carry a data preview -- row counts and configured filters only.

outputs.description: DataFrame of booked appointment records returned by Zocdoc's GET /v1/appointments (fields vary; may include PHI such as patient name/contact info -- see README PHI Safety section).

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key of the ZocdocResource this asset depends on for authentication

from_date_time.label: From Date/Time
from_date_time.description: Start of the appointment start-time window (ISO-8601) -> start_time_utc_min. Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

to_date_time.label: To Date/Time
to_date_time.description: End of the appointment start-time window (ISO-8601) -> start_time_utc_max. Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

practice_ids.label: Practice Ids
practice_ids.description: Comma-separated Zocdoc practice ids to filter on.

provider_ids.label: Provider Ids
provider_ids.description: Comma-separated Zocdoc provider ids to filter on.

location_ids.label: Location Ids
location_ids.description: Comma-separated Zocdoc location ids to filter on.

statuses.label: Statuses
statuses.description: Comma-separated appointment statuses to filter on (e.g. 'booked,confirmed').

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of appointments to fetch across all pages (safety cap).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:foo) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['zocdoc', 'python'].

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Zocdoc Appointments Ingestion
